This '''unidentified individual''' served as the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] for [[General/Legends|General]] [[Eldo Davip]] in [[44 ABY]]. The pilot was present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]] when the participants of the [[Tendrando Arms Celebrity Sabacc Charity Challenge]] came off the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Errant Venture/Legends|Errant Venture]]''.<ref name="Conviction" />
